text: {"lessons":["My account fell for three periods before I traded, so I should remember that doing nothing does not eliminate market risk.","I bought across all five stocks, then added to A and D; I should keep diversification in mind and avoid concentrating more just because of short-term price moves.","The small gain after my latest buys does not prove the trades were good; I should judge decisions over time and keep my apartment goal and risk tolerance in view."]}
